QUOTE: `library/error.c` is generated, not hand-written. The generator is `scripts/generate_errors.pl`, and its template is `scripts/data_files/error.fmt`. The generator: - scans `include/mbedtls/*.h` for `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_\w+ -0x...`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states error.c is generated from the public headers by generate_errors.pl using error.fmt as its template.
